thesis: Profitable, fast-growing engineering-services-turned-manufacturer that the market has repriced as a semiconductor proxy: FY26 revenue +83% to Rs 529cr, PAT +142% to Rs 60.76cr, Q1 FY27 NP +72% — but the price has run far ahead of any fundamentals the frozen engine can justify (15.3x DCF FV). All quality gates pass mechanically, yet two things kill it as an entry: the BSE procedural fine vetoes the event lane until May-2027, and the anchor demands a ~94% fall before the first trigger. The Rs 526cr preferential (SBI MF, Damani vehicle, Mukul Agrawal family) validates the growth story without validating the price. Watch, don't chase.
